page.layout: One page of text, one column of verse lines, set in italic with a running head at the top. No margin notes, no footnotes.

l.i: Non ignota loquor. stabunt placida aquora Sentis
Extemplo, & sultus cælum induet omne sereno
Sic ait ingeminans, custantésque increpat sltre
Tunc Sero ingente clamore ad sydera tollun
Etsimul, ò, dextras facimus si forte nocentes
Magne Deum genitor, solidis compesce catenis:
Scilicet hic nobis nec crimine cognitus sllo est,
Publica nec lethi nobis concessa potestas.
Sin tibi sic placitum meritas infligere pœnas,
Nec fallit manifesta tui sententia Vatis,
Da Senstam, da blandus opem, atque hæc omina
firma.
His dictis, puppi Antistes deuoluitur altâ.
Illum & labentem cunctli, & sidere natantem
Nequicquam, & salsos reuomente pectore fluctus,
Æternum periisse rati, lacrymasque dedere.
At placidum Sentis stetit effugientibus æquor
Extemplo, & sultus cælum induit omne serenes.
Lenior inde Viris cursus dedit aura secundos.
Tuc quoque multa pia duplicat formidine Sota,
Et steriles ritus pictorum odere Deorum.
Interea monstrum ecce oculis mirabile Pristes
Ter denis magnos cubitis protentus in artus,
Seu Pristes, seu Sifu aliud mirabile manstrum,
Æquoreum per iter Sastâ se mole mouebat.
Qualia sæpe mari nauta speculantur in alto
Corpora cetorum, non sex Sectanda quadrigis.
Nec mora, commeriti plestendus carceris Smbrâ
Corripitur Vates, monstriqueinfaucibus atris
Terquê

page.notes: The first line of the scan is partly cut off at the right edge, and several words at the line ends are cropped. The long s is printed as s in this type; transcribed as plain s where clear. Doubtful: "Senstam", "Sota", "Sastâ", "Sifu", "Smbrâ" and "Sectanda", which may be misprints or damaged letters; the "S" for "F" forms in the scan were read as printed. The final line "Terquê" is set at the right margin and may be incomplete.
